Title: New look for Azure Storage overview blade in the portal

Body.Content:
We’ve updated the overview blade for storage accounts in the Azure portal. The new experience loads faster. It also allows quickly accessible links to storage services such as for viewing metrics, configuring CORS rules, and setting up a custom domain.

Also, we’ve upgraded the metrics charts in the overview. Clicking these charts links directly to the integrated monitoring experience in the Azure portal.
